work.name: Articul
highlights: Supports AI-driven business development through analyst network building, outreach research, and experimentation on partnership and pipeline workflows.

work.name: UNC Medical School Boerwinkle Lab
highlights: Designed a privacy-preserving clinical notes pipeline for epilepsy cohort analytics, transforming 350+ notes across 100+ patients into analysis-ready JSON/CSV; integrated Epic FHIR retrieval to assemble patient-linked longitudinal histories.

Implemented validation checks (schema consistency, completeness, deduping) to improve longitudinal dataset reliability; raised validation pass rate by 30% through prompt iteration and evaluation on 220+ labeled notes.
Partnered with 3 neurology clinicians to define requirements and validate outputs, ensuring stakeholder communication and alignment throughout delivery.

work.name: HireBeat Inc.
highlights: Developed 3 client-facing Tableau KPI dashboards tracking 12 metrics across 4 workstreams; reduced reporting turnaround by 20% and supported consulting recommendations on automation ROI.

Prototyped an internal RAG-based knowledge tool to accelerate policy/process lookup from ~20 minutes to ~5 minutes; summarized findings into business insights and exec-ready recommendations for ROI prioritization.

Synthesized technical findings into decision-oriented guidance for stakeholders, translating root-cause drivers and product constraints into actionable insights, business impact, and concrete next steps.

work.name: Interactive Insights PR Consultancy
highlights: Led data-driven benchmarking of 6 global pediatric nutrition brands for Feihe's Philippines expansion; built a structured feature/pricing dataset adopted by 2 teams and reduced analysis turnaround from 7 to 4 days.

Performed customer sentiment analysis of 500+ Amazon reviews in Python (Pandas); identified 3 key sentiment themes; created 9 Matplotlib visualizations embedded in the client-facing deck to support positioning decisions.

Authored a 4-page positioning brief translating review insights into 3 messaging pillars (digestion, taste acceptance, nutrition benefits) with review-backed proof points to support product messaging and differentiation.

projects.name: Sports Video Analytics Pipeline
projects.summary: Built an end-to-end basketball video analytics pipeline that converts raw game film into structured tracking and event-level tables, enabling KPI reporting (shot quality, defensive efficiency, turnover rate) and ad hoc breakdowns by player, lineup, and possession.
highlights: Processed 18 full games (40+ hours of video), generated 400+ player tracks with automated QC checks.
Improved throughput from 95 min/game to 28 min/game via batching, frame skipping, and pipeline profiling.

projects.name: NCAA Basketball Wins Prediction
projects.summary: Built a supervised learning pipeline to predict NCAA game outcomes using historical team-level data spanning 10 seasons and 365 teams, performing data quality and exploratory analysis to produce a reusable modeling dataset.
highlights: Engineered features (efficiency margins, rolling averages) and benchmarked models with cross-validation.
Achieved 68% accuracy / 0.74 AUC vs a 50% baseline, and summarized drivers using feature importance and error analysis.
